description.zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh:
通知类型列表，传null值则不过滤类型。

- GATEWAY_OFFLINE：网关离线信息。

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING：凭证授权中。

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED：凭证授权成功。

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED：撤销凭证授权。

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED：拒绝凭证授权。
description.en:
The list of notification types. Set this parameter to null to skip type filtering. Valid values:

- GATEWAY_OFFLINE: gateway offline information.

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_APPLYING: credential authorization in progress.

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_ACCEPTED: credential authorization succeeded.

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_CANCELED: credential authorization revoked.

- JOIN_PERMISSION_AUTH_REJECTED: credential authorization rejected.

description.zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的 UNIX 时间戳。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

description.zh: 根据通知处理状态过滤，传null值则不过滤处理状态。
description.en: Filters notifications by processing status. Set this parameter to null to skip status filtering.

title.zh: 统计符合过滤条件的通知数量
title.en: Count notifications that match filter conditions
